newsitem.title: JAPAN: Suzutan shares slide to record low.
newsitem.headline: Suzutan shares slide to record low.

text.p: Shares in Suzutan Co Ltd slid to an all-time low on Wednesday, depressed by news late on Tuesday that Japan's securities watchdog had filed accusations with prosecutors of insider trading against three former Suzutan officials and a former official of a subsidiary.
Suzutan is a major women's wear retailer.

The share price briefly hit a lifetime low of 165 yen earlier on the session. At 0518 GMT, it was down 22 yen at 170, making it the fifth-steepest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
